description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.

description:

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

description:

Reed Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for one of the UKâs leading multi-discipline Civil Engineering and Building contractors, for a Civils Estimator. This role offers a fantastic opportunity for career development and progression within a dynamic team.


Day-to-day of the role:

  • Provide a comprehensive estimating service, controlling either an assigned project or a portfolio of projects.
  • Identify potential risks from initial analysis of project documentation.
  • Prepare tender estimates from first principles using Conquest estimating software, drawing on previous experience and knowledge of techniques, outputs, subcontractor quotations, and material prices unique to each tender.

  • Obtain feedback from site teams on estimating adequacy and current costs.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • HND/C in Civil Engineering.
  • At least two years of previous experience working in an Estimating Department.
  • Thorough understanding of construction techniques, outputs, and the relationship between costs from these and the market values and how this is utilised in tendering.
  • Forming bills of quantities from drawings take-offs, either by hand or from Estimating software.

Desirable:

  • Knowledge and experience of CESMM, SMM Methods of Measurement, production of activity schedules, and population of contract sum analyses.
  • Ability to work independently utilising several standard forms of contract such as NEC/JCT and bespoke contracts.


Benefits:

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in the following types of projects will be preferred:

  • Hotels / Hospitality Projects
  • Commercial Buildings
  • High-rise Buildings
  • Residential & Commercial Complexes
  • Large-scale Civil Construction Projects

title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Embedded Software Engineer (m/f/d)

description:
Your mission

Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

You'll work primarily on external customer projects with a Python-based tech stack, while also contributing in parallel to our products built on Java Spring Boot. You design and implement robust microservices that process and distribute large volumes of orbital and telemetry data to deliver reliable APIs and automation processes. You already bring solid experience and take independent ownership of parts of the backend architecture across both environments.

You'll work on the systems that enable satellite operators and space agencies to analyze, coordinate, and protect their missions in an increasingly crowded space environment.

Studies show that women are less likely to apply for a position if they don't meet 100% of the requirements. Please know that we explicitly encourage you to apply if this applies to you, as long as you bring a passion for space technology, reliable software development, and sustainable use of space.
OKAPI:Orbits already brings together a highly diverse team and is actively committed to growing that diversity further, since studies show that heterogeneous teams achieve better results and drive innovation.


Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain asynchronous, microservice-based backend systems, primarily in Python for external customer projects and in parallel in Java Spring Boot for our products
  • Implement and optimize data processing and distribution pipelines that handle large volumes of orbital, telemetry, and mission data
  • Design and maintain message-based communication structures between microservices (e.g., via RabbitMQ or comparable message brokers)
  • Collaborate closely with space engineers and scientists to translate mission-related requirements into scalable, robust software solutions
  • Share responsibility for the backend architecture across both tech stacks, with a focus on performance, fault tolerance, and maintainability
  • Plan and document implementation steps, from system architecture through deployment in a cloud-native environment
  • Ensure code quality, automated testing, and adherence to security and development standards
  • Advance CI/CD pipelines, observability, and automation to support stable, continuous releases
  • Analyze and resolve complex issues in distributed systems with a focus on efficiency and reliability
  • Work within small, interdisciplinary teams, contributing your backend expertise to cross-functional projects


Your profile

Must-haves

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or completed vocational training as a Fachinformatiker (IT specialist)
  • At least 2 years of professional experience with Python for backend development, scripting, automation, or data processing
  • At least 2 years of professional experience in backend software development with Java (Spring Boot or comparable)
  • Solid understanding of microservice architectures, asynchronous systems, and distributed communication patterns
  • Practical experience with testing and code quality assurance
  • Experience with, or willingness to quickly get up to speed on, message-based communication between services (e.g., RabbitMQ or comparable message brokers) and containerization (Docker)
  • Ability to independently plan, implement, and review complex features in close collaboration with engineers and scientists
  • Proactive communication, structured way of working, and good written and spoken English
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with orchestration, particularly Kubernetes
  • Experience with code reviews and adherence to coding standards
  • Solid understanding of software architecture principles, including modular structure, scalability, and maintainability
  • Experience with secure software development
  • Background in or interest in the space or aerospace sector


Why us?

  • Flat hierarchy, small teams, flexible working hours
  • Up to 30 days’ vacation & up to 30 days’ workation per year 
  • Early responsibility, influence on the technical direction
  • Training budget for your personal development
  • Career paths to support and promote your long-term development
  • Corporate benefits (brand discounts, travel discounts, concert tickets, etc.)
  • Free German language course
  • Bahncard (25 within Braunschweig, 50 outside) 
  • Bike leasing 
  • Company pension scheme 
  • Subsidy towards Hansefit / Wellpass membership 
  • Participation in space events and conferences to promote sustainable space travel

title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.

Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Creative Designer, der visuell starke und performanceorientierte Creatives für unsere Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages und unseren Onlineshop entwickelt.

Du solltest nicht nur ein ausgezeichnetes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie und Bildsprache besitzen, sondern auch verstehen, wie Designs im E-Commerce funktionieren: von einem aufmerksamkeitsstarken Einstieg über eine klare visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zu einer überzeugenden Produktinszenierung und einem eindeutigen Call-to-Action.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst performanceorientierte statische Werbeanzeigen und Grafiken für Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google und weitere digitale Kanäle.
  • Du gestaltest unterschiedliche Creative Angles, Hooks, Layouts und Varianten, damit wir Botschaften und visuelle Ansätze gezielt testen können.
  • Du verwandelst Produktbilder, UGC-Material, Testimonials, Benefits und Werbetexte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke und verkaufsorientierte Creatives.
  • Du gestaltest visuelle Konzepte, Seitenlayouts und einzelne Bereiche für Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.
  • Du entwickelst unter anderem Hero Sections, Produkt-Benefit-Grafiken, Vergleichsdarstellungen, Anwendungsanleitungen, Vorher-Nachher-Visuals, Trust-Elemente und weitere Conversion-Elemente.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Marke, Produkt, Anwendung, Vorteile und Ergebnisse von AYLASHES hochwertig und verständlich präsentiert werden.
  • Du adaptierst Creatives für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Platzierungen und Formate – insbesondere 1:1, 4:5 und 9:16 sowie weitere Display- und Webformate.
  • Du achtest bei allen Formaten auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit, mobile Darstellung und eine konsistente visuelle Qualität.
  • Du entwickelst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Bildern, Headlines, Farben, Layouts oder CTAs.
  • Du setzt bestehende Brand-Vorgaben sicher um und entwickelst unsere visuelle Kommunikation gemeinsam mit uns weiter.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team zusammen, setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst eigene Ideen und Empfehlungen ein.

title: Senior Controller (all genders)
description:
Want to make a difference?

As Senior Controller (all genders), you play a key role in the financial steering of ARMEDANGELS. With your strategic perspective on numbers, processes, and business performance, you help ensure that sustainable growth is built on a strong and reliable financial foundation.

You take ownership of further developing budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, create transparency around financial performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business. In doing so, you combine financial excellence with our ambition to operate responsibly and with long-term impact in mind.


Who we are...

Since 2007, ARMEDANGELS has been proving that fashion can be different: innovative and timeless, produced according to responsible standards for people and planet. No wage slavery, no toxic chemicals, no cheap throwaway goods.

What started as a simple idea – printing T-shirts and donating proceeds to social projects – has grown into a company that now ranks among Europe’s leading sustainable lifestyle labels. With a 190-strong team and four collections a year, we show that responsibility and great product design can go hand in hand.


What is the job about?

Strategic Financial Planning & Analysis

You lead and further develop our budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, ensuring they are aligned with our business and growth objectives.

You analyze financial performance, conduct variance analyses, and derive actionable recommendations to support better business decisions.

Internal Controls & Compliance

You will develop and strengthen internal control mechanisms, helping to identify risks early on and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards. 

You will assist with annual financial statement audits in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), participate in audits, and, when necessary, coordinate the implementation of required measures from a controlling perspective.

Financial Reporting & Performance Monitoring

You oversee the preparation of meaningful financial reports, including P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet analysis, creating transparency on the company’s financial performance.

You use KPIs and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and support financial steering.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support

You work closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and other business functions to integrate financial insights into broader business planning.

You prepare decision-ready analyses for senior stakeholders and help ensure strategic choices are grounded in reliable financial data.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

You support and develop colleagues in Finance and Controlling, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

You drive process enhancements and introduce tools, methods, and best practices that improve efficiency and quality in a sustainable way.


We'd love to hear from you if you have

Professional

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Experience with internal controls and compliance-related processes
  • You have knowledge of the German Commercial Code (HGB) and a solid understanding of accounting principles, enabling you to effectively integrate controlling and accounting perspectives.
Personal
  • Strategic and analytical mindset
  • Structured, precise, and solution-oriented way of working
  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence in working with different stakeholders
  • Motivation to support teams and actively improve processes


What can you expect?

Inspiring work environment: Work in an innovative company that operates as sustainably as possible and continuously sets new standards.

Flexibility: Trust-based working hours and the option to work in a hybrid setup.

Team spirit: Enjoy legendary team events, a historic office space, and plenty of dog-friendly energy.

Benefits: €50 monthly benefit via guudcard, ARMEDANGELS shopping vouchers, attractive employee discounts, a JobRad or Germany Ticket, and a company pension scheme.

title: Werkstudent Foodservice | Robotic Kitchens (all genders welcome)
description:
Deine Rolle

Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time.
    
Mit unseren Robotern verändern wir, wie die Welt kocht, isst und genießt. Durch Technologie, die Gastronomien entlastet, automatisiert frisches Essen zubereitet und kulinarische Qualität auf ein neues, skalierbares Level hebt. Zugänglich für alle. Überall und jederzeit. Dafür geben wir alles. Auf allen Ebenen, in jedem Team und in jeder Funktion.

Als Werkstudent:in im Foodservice unserer Robotic Kitchen Operations sorgst du dafür, dass unser autonomer Kochroboter vor Ort bei unserem Kunden in Heikendorf (bei Kiel) reibungslos läuft. Du bedienst und überwachst das System im laufenden Betrieb, bereitest frische Zutaten vor, behältst die Kochprozesse im Blick – und bist gleichzeitig herzliche:r Gastgeber:in für unsere Gäste.

Diese Aufgaben übernimmst du: 

  • Roboter-Betrieb: Du bedienst und überwachst unseren Kochroboter im laufenden Betrieb – vor Ort bei unserem Kunden in Heikendorf (bei Kiel).
  • Mise en Place: Du bereitest Zutaten frisch vor und befüllst damit den Roboter.
  • Qualitätsüberwachung: Du behältst jeden Kochschritt im Blick und sorgst für konstante Qualität und korrekte Portionen.
  • Gästebetreuung: Du begrüßt unsere Gäste herzlich, beantwortest ihre Fragen und unterstützt sie im Umgang mit unserem Roboter.
  • Sauberkeit & Hygiene: Du hältst die Station rund um den Roboter sauber, prüfst das System täglich und sorgst für einwandfreie Hygiene nach HACCP-Standard.


Dein Profil

Du brennst für innovative Technologien, begeisterst dich für die Rolle und willst gemeinsam mit uns die Welten von Tech & Kulinarik weiter revolutionieren? Let’s get cooking!

Diese Eigenschaften bringst du idealerweise mit: 

  • Neugier & Offenheit: Du hast Lust, mit unserem Kochroboter zu arbeiten, probierst gerne Neues aus und bist fasziniert von innovativer Technik in der Küche.
  • Freude an Technik & Kulinarik: Du verbindest Begeisterung für moderne Technologien mit einem Faible für gutes Essen.
  • Motivation & Hands-on: Du bist motiviert, zeigst Energie und packst auch gerne selbst mit an.
  • Flexibilität & Zuverlässigkeit: Ob unter der Woche oder am Wochenende – du bist flexibel einsetzbar und auf dich ist Verlass.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du sprichst gut Deutsch und hast mind. Englisch-Grundkenntnisse – zur sicheren Kommunikation mit Gästen und Team.
  • Gastronomie-Erfahrung als Plus: Erste Erfahrungen aus Küche und/oder Service sind ein Bonus – aber keine Voraussetzung.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
Lead Product Designer (YouTrack)
C++/Kotlin Software Developer (RustRover Debugger)
Lead Data Architect
description:
Our mission

At LOGEX, we turn data into better healthcare.

As we continue to scale our healthcare intelligence platform across Europe, we're investing in a modern, unified data foundation that supports analytics, AI, and data-driven decision-making across our products and services.

You will define the future-state architecture that enables this vision. You will establish the standards, models, and principles that ensure our data is well-structured, interoperable, secure, and trusted across the organisation.

This is a highly visible role with broad influence across Data Engineering, Product, Platform, Governance, and AI teams. You will play a key role in shaping how LOGEX manages and leverages data as we continue to grow, including through acquisitions and expansion across Europe.

Your impact and responsibilities

Define the target-state data architecture

Own and evolve the enterprise data architecture, creating a clear roadmap from the current state to a scalable and future-proof data platform.

Establish data standards and architecture principles

Define the modelling, integration, interoperability, and storage standards that enable consistency across teams and products.

Drive data modelling excellence

Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models while ensuring semantic consistency and trusted business definitions across the organisation.

Enable governance by design

Embed governance, lineage, security, privacy, and compliance requirements directly into the data architecture.

Support analytics and AI at scale

Ensure the architecture provides the foundations required for reliable analytics, data products, and AI-driven capabilities.

Provide technical leadership

Act as the senior architectural authority across distributed teams, helping engineers and data practitioners make sound design decisions while reducing fragmentation and technical debt.

What you will do

  • Define and maintain the target-state enterprise data architecture.

  • Create and drive the roadmap towards a unified data platform.

  • Develop standards for data modelling, integration, interoperability, and storage.

  • Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

  • Define canonical data structures and business definitions.

  • Support engineering teams with architectural guidance and design reviews.

  • Ensure governance, lineage, security, privacy, and compliance are built into platform design.

  • Partner with Data Governance, Product, Platform, and AI teams to align architecture with business goals.

  • Evaluate data technologies, tooling, and architectural trade-offs.

  • Improve consistency across teams while reducing complexity and technical debt.

  • Support the integration of acquired businesses into the broader LOGEX data landscape.


Your profile

  • Significant experience as a Data Architect, Lead Data Architect, or in a senior data architecture or engineering role.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data architectures.

  • Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.

  • Experience with modern cloud-based data platforms and data integration architectures.

  • Knowledge of data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, and master data management.

  • Understanding of the foundations required for analytics, AI, and data products.

  • Ability to influence and align multiple teams without direct authority.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic, hands-on, and outcome-oriented mindset.

Why LOGEX?

  • An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance)

  • An informal working environment with motivated colleagues

  • The possibility to work in a hybrid setup

  • A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office

  • Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy

  • Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp

  • Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

As Security Architect, you will report directly to the Head of Information Security & Compliance and play a key role in strengthening LOGEX's security maturity. This is not a traditional enterprise architecture role focused on creating frameworks and presentations. We are looking for a security practitioner who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, working closely with engineering teams, solving real security challenges, and driving measurable risk reduction. You will work alongside software engineers, data engineers, and platform teams across multiple countries to ensure security is built into everything we do.

Detection & Incident Response

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Translate requirements from GDPR, ISO 27001, and customer security standards into practical technical controls

  • Collaborate with Information Security, Legal, and Data Protection teams

Your profile

description:
Dein täglicher Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Der operative Betrieb unseres internen IT-Bereichs liegt in deinen Händen: Du packst selbst mit an, strukturierst Themen und sorgst dafür, dass technische Aufgaben pragmatisch umgesetzt werden.
  • Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team stellst du den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Office IT-Infrastruktur und unserer Microsoft-basierten Arbeitsumgebung sicher.

  • In IT- und Informationssicherheits-Audits sowie regelmäßigen Zertifizierungen sorgst du dafür, dass Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten und Nachweise sauber aufgebaut und gepflegt werden.


Deine Kompetenzen:

  • Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Umgebungen mit.
  • Microsoft-basierte Unternehmensumgebungen sind dir vertraut und du verstehst, wie eine sichere und skalierbare IT für ein wachsendes Unternehmen aufgebaut wird.
  • IT-Projekte kannst du strukturieren, Prioritäten setzen und unterschiedliche Aufgaben, Beteiligte und Abhängigkeiten zuverlässig zusammenführen.

  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen IT-Dienstleistern ist dir vertraut und du kannst technische Empfehlungen kritisch einordnen.
  • Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung von Kolleg:innenist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung; wichtiger ist, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich in eine Führungsrolle weiterentwickeln möchtest.
  • Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du sicher und kommunizierst mit technischen Teams ebenso souverän wie mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern.


Unsere Werte, dein Mindset:

  • Team First: Ein Team, ein Ziel - Gemeinsam sind wir stark. Wir wachsen durch gegenseitige Unterstützung.
  • Customer Success Is Our DNA: Identifiziere, hinterfrage und verfolge die Ziele Deines Kunden. Feiert gemeinsam den Erfolg.
  • Never Stop Reinventing: Sei offen für Neues und gehe Veränderungen mutig an. Hinterfrage Prozesse, liefere Lösungsvorschläge und neue Ideen.
  • Be Yourself And Make Goals Work: Sei Du selbst. Erreiche Großes!


Deine Benefits bei uns:

  • Remote Work: Flexibles Arbeitsmodell - arbeite bis zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder nutze unser modernes Office in Hamburg.
  • Urlaub: Mehr Zeit für das, was dir wichtig ist - zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du deinen Jahresurlaub durch Gehaltsumwandlung auf bis zu 40 Tage erhöhen.
  • Workation: Arbeiten, wo du dich inspirieren lässt - arbeite einmal pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland. Nach zwei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit sind sogar weitere internationale Workation-Möglichkeiten möglich.
  • Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen - mit unserer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung erhältst du ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für zahlreiche Gesundheitsleistungen. 
  • Dein Wahlbenefit: Du entscheidest, was am besten zu deinem Alltag passt - wähle zwischen einem Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club, einem bezuschussten JobTicket oder einer Edenred-Sachbezugskarte für deine Einkäufe. 
  • JobRad: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder deine Freizeit - lease dein JobRad über uns und profitiere von attraktiven steuerlichen Vorteilen. 
  • Altersvorsorge: Wir denken heute schon an morgen - sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss. 
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Raum für Eigeninitiative statt starrer Hierarchien - übernimm Verantwortung, bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte die Zukunft der Reos Gruppe aktiv mit.
  • Networking: Zweimal im Jahr kommt die gesamte Reos Gruppe in Hamburg zusammen - freue dich auf unvergessliche Firmenevents, persönlichen Austausch und echte gemeinsame Erlebnisse.

title: Senior Product Manager Service Subscriptions (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen

...als Senior Product Manager Aftersales Subscriptions (m/w/d). Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für unser Service- und Wartungsabo. Dein Fokus liegt darauf, das Portfolio von der Tarifstruktur über den Leistungsumfang bis zur Preisgestaltung so zu entwickeln, dass es für unsere Kund:innen einen klaren Mehrwert bietet und zugleich wiederkehrende Umsätze sowie ein profitables Aftersales-Geschäft schafft.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • unser Service- und Wartungsportfolio end-to-end zu verantworten: von Tarifstufen und Leistungsversprechen über Service-Level bis zur Abgrenzung zwischen enthaltenen und separat berechneten Leistungen
  • die wirtschaftliche Grundlage des Produkts zu bauen und zu verteidigen: Tarifstruktur, Preise, Deckungsbeitrag, Kosten pro Vertrag, Rückstellungen, Break-even, Indexierung und Kündigungslogik festzulegen sowie über die wesentlichen Bausteine des Produkts als Make-or-Buy-Entscheidung zu befinden, von der langfristigen Absicherung über die Abrechnung bis zum Tooling
  • das Abo aus dem bisherigen Aftersales-Prozess in den Angebotsmoment zu bringen und Sales sowie Service mit Argumentation, Materialien und klaren Abläufen auszustatten
  • gemeinsam mit Legal und externen Berater:innen Verträge, Bedingungen und Kundentexte zu entwickeln, die auch im Detail belastbar sind
  • Anforderungen an Checkout, CRM, Vertragsdatenmodell, Berechtigungslogik, Abrechnung und Mahnwesen zu definieren, bestehende Verträge zu migrieren und das Produkt weiterzuentwickeln


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium: idealerweise in BWL, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Ein anderer Werdegang mit passender Praxiserfahrung ist ebenfalls willkommen. 
  • Product Ownership: Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens drei Jahre im Produktmanagement eines kommerziell verantworteten Abo-, Service- oder Vertragsprodukts. Du hast Preise festgelegt, Margen verantwortet und die Folgen deiner Entscheidungen an Churn, Schadensfällen oder Servicekosten gesehen
  • Commercial & Quantitative Depth: Du entwickelst und prüfst Business Cases selbst. Dabei erkennst du, welche Annahme das Modell kippen kann, und leitest daraus klare Entscheidungen ab
  • AI-First: Du nutzt KI- und Low-Code-Tools, um Prototypen, Automatisierungen und erste Lösungen selbst zu bauen. Du weißt zugleich, an welcher Stelle echte Engineering-Kapazität nötig ist
  • Vertragsverständnis: Du arbeitest präzise mit Legal und externen Berater:innen und erkennst früh, welche kommerzielle Idee rechtlich oder regulatorisch angepasst werden muss
  • Arbeitsweise: Du gehst in die Serviceorganisation, liest Claims- und Servicedaten und sprichst mit den Menschen, die das Produkt im Alltag ausführen. Auch bei Widerspruch hältst du eine begründete Position und änderst sie, wenn die Fakten es verlangen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau
Tiefes Wärmepumpen- oder Heizungswissen ist keine Voraussetzung und wird im Prozess nicht bewertet. Diese Tiefe haben wir im Haus. Was wir suchen, ist Produktverantwortung für ein Abo-Geschäft und die Fähigkeit, selbst zu bauen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€*
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Beweg Dich mit Deinem JobRad, klimafreundlich durch die Stadt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem mıt FINN JobAuto Leasing.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben 30 Tagen Urlaub und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die Corporate Benefits auch eine vergünstigte Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu nilo.health, einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge.
  • Sicherheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur bAV und BUV wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20% unterstützt.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.

Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.

Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.


Salary information

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

As the Tech Lead for the backend, frontend, mobile and fullstack software engineers, you will own and shape the architecture of the underlying services as well as their technical roadmap for the services that together create Treeline, our application that helps predict and prevent wildfires, storm events and generally power and train outages due to vegetation, weather and climate.

Technically, that means rendering and querying large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in both browser, mobile and backend, handling complex and custom business logic, writing the services that make that fast, and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.

We are a team of five engineers today, actively growing, embedded in a cross-functional group of product managers, UX/UI designers, data, DevOps, ML, and geospatial engineering experts. You will not be the only person responsible for any system you touch and we’re a friendly bunch.


Your challenge

  • Lead, support and coordinate the team that builds Treeline while still being around 60% hands-on
  • Architect, build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Design and build well-designed, performant API endpoints and backend services used by partners and customers
  • Coordinate tightly with other functions in cross-functional temporary squads
  • Shape and influence how your team works and how we work together in a greater context

Stack:
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: NestJS, TypeORM
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads, PostGIS and OGC)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: AWS, GitLab


Your profile

Must have

  • First experience as a techlead, knowing that the team and product takes priority over your own hands-on work, always
  • Strong Backend experience with NestJS, Express, or Node.js
  • High level of TypeScript, React in production (Vue or Preact also fine — we care that you know a component model well, not which one)
  • Familiarity with mobile development, especially React Native
  • You've worked in a codebase with CI/CD and code review, and can find your way around a system you didn't build
  • You've used AI-assisted coding in your actual day-to-day, not just tried it once
Nice to have

  • Web-based geospatial / GIS work

title: Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. Our platforms Treeline, SurfaceScout, and TradeAware, help utilities, energy companies, rail operators, and global supply chains monitor vegetation risk, third-party interference, ground changes, and deforestation exposure across millions of kilometers of assets and supply chains, from space.

We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. This is a player-leader role for someone who has run distributed technical teams before, speaks fluently in geospatial and remote-sensing technology, has sold software-enabled services rather than pure-play SaaS, and has embedded MEDDPICC and value-selling discipline into a sales engine at scale.

As Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x), you will own the strategy, people, and technical rigor behind LiveEO's global pre-sales motion. You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. You'll partner closely with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, and Product leadership to make sure every region sells with the same technical credibility, the same value discipline, and the same customer-first mindset.


Your challenge

1. Global Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and scale an international Sales Engineering team across North America, EMEA, and APAC; own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for regional SEs and SE managers.

  • Set global SE strategy, headcount plan, and capacity model aligned to pipeline coverage and quota targets.

  • Establish consistent standards, certification, and career pathing so SEs anywhere in the world operate at the same bar.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaborative deal support across regions and time zones.

2. Geospatial & Technical Depth

  • Serve as the most senior technical authority in the sales organization on Earth Observation, remote sensing, GIS, and satellite analytics, and translate that expertise into customer-facing value.

  • Own the technical narrative for complex RFPs/RFIs, enterprise architecture discussions, and system integrations (GIS, EAM, ERP, SCADA/OMS/DMS).

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to represent field and customer technical requirements back into the roadmap.

  • Personally engage on the company's largest, most technically complex, or highest-visibility opportunities, including large enterprise accounts.

3. MEDDPICC & Value Selling

  • Embed and continuously improve MEDDPICC qualification discipline across the global SE team, in lockstep with Sales leadership.

  • Own the SE contribution to the Value Framework, Deal Sheets, ROI modeling, and Champion Building processes; make quantified business cases the default, not the exception.

  • Coach SEs and AEs on champions, economic buyer engagement, decision-criteria influence, and competitive positioning.

  • Track and report qualification quality and value-selling maturity as a leading indicator of pipeline health.

4. Customer Advocacy

  • Act as the voice of the customer inside LiveEO — ensuring product, delivery, and pricing decisions reflect real technical and operational realities in the field.

  • Build senior technical relationships with strategic accounts and act as an executive technical sponsor on flagship and expansion deals.

  • Champion customer success stories and reference-ability back into sales and marketing.

5. Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success on GTM strategy, forecasting, and territory/resourcing planning for the global SE function.

  • Partner with the Directors of product to provide field feedback to help drive the product roadmap forward.

  • Represent Sales Engineering in executive and board-level reporting on pipeline quality, win rates, and technical risk.

  • Own SE playbooks, demo environments, and enablement content in partnership with RevOps and Product Marketing.


Your profile

  • 8+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or technical pre-sales, including 4+ years leading distributed/global teams across multiple regions and time zones.

  • Enterprise experience, a demonstrated track record selling to and supporting complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders and long, technical sales cycles.

  • Strong working knowledge of geospatial and remote sensing technologies, satellite/Earth Observation imagery, GIS, spatial analytics with the ability to speak credibly to technical buyers.

  • Experience with software-enabled services business models.

  • Demonstrated track record embedding MEDDPICC (or a comparable qualification framework) and quantitative value-selling/ROI methodology across a sales organization.
